FINAL ANSWER (primary model, per approved approach): **p = 0.0865** (≈ 0.087)

Model specification (one line): Univariate logistic regression, n=80, outcome = treatment response (Efficacy: PR=1 vs SD+PD=0), predictor = BMI (continuous, per-unit); BMI coefficient Wald p-value = 0.0865 (β = 0.168, OR/unit = 1.18, 95% CI 0.976–1.433; likelihood-ratio cross-check p = 0.0812, consistent).

Interpretation: BMI is not statistically significantly associated with treatment response at α=0.05 (borderline, p ≈ 0.087); higher BMI shows a positive direction of effect (OR > 1).

(2) Sensitivity results (report-only):
- S1 — alternative outcome coding PR+SD vs PD: p = 0.0748
- S2 — BMI categorical ≥23 vs <23: p = 0.1468
- S3 — BMI <18.5 (underweight) vs rest: p = 0.1831
- S4 — multivariable (BMI + Age + ECOG-PS + Child-Pugh + HBV + Gender + Family history + Chemo experience; Groups excluded due to complete separation): BMI p = 0.1972
FLAG (as instructed): primary aur S4 materially diverge karti hain (0.0865 vs 0.197) — multivariable adjustment BMI ka effect absorb kar deta hai (covariates, especially Child-Pugh/ECOG, treatment arm ke saath strongly aligned hain aur n=80 par 8 parameters overfit-prone hain). Final answer sirf primary p-value use karti hai: 0.087. S1 (0.075) primary ke qareeb hai; categorical codings (S2/S3) mein power loss ki wajah se p-values barh jaate hain.

(3) Preprocessing verification (aapki caution par): script mein hard assertions hain — preprocessing ke baad n=80, Sequence number exactly 1..80 (unique, complete), analytical columns mein zero missing, aur Groups × response ki perfect separation preprocessing ke baad bhi intact hai (Group 1: 41/41 PR; Group 2: 0/41 PR). Yani blank-row handling ne koi data row drop ya misalign nahi ki; separation data ka genuine feature hai. Ek data anomaly note: ECOG-PS column mixed-dtype hai (kuch cells integer 2, kuch string '0-1') — pehli S4 attempt mein is se singular matrix aayi thi (meri coding bug, data nahi); string-normalize karke fix kiya.

(4) Execution: script analysis/run_analysis.py end-to-end run hui (exit 0), output analysis/full_output.txt aur analysis/results.txt mein saved. executed_analysis=true set ki ja rahi hai.
